steps.content: After stepping out of the dark alley, the Public Security Bureau is right ahead indeed, but more thugs are also around.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We're outnumbered. It's difficult to protect the Chief without cover here.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They are even rowdier now. Do we have no other support? Did the Public Security Bureau only send one jerk to meet you?!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't worry. MBCC will help you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Face 11 o'clock and advance 14 meters to find the <color=#fb9259>support</color> we prepared for you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There are enemies nearby. They will spot us soon.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's okay. Once you get there, the power there can help you breakthrough.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Shut up, I'm trying to find it! Where's the armored car and the rocket artillery? Where are the supports they promised? There's only a *** dumpster here!
She furiously gives it a kick, then a low grunt sounds from the dumpster, in which hides a tied-up... woman dressed like a hooligan.
Let me go! Do the sheriffs just arrest anyone nowadays? What else have I done apart from delivering takeaways?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sinner S-217, <color=#fb9259>K.K.</color> Use the shackles, Chief. She can be your power.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...But she said she didn't do anything wrong.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We'll check her background later, which won't be difficult to do in Syndicate.
